name: The Five Sided Triangle
source:
In the distant future, a political meeting is the target of a string of successive murders. Will the culprit be found out? 
Currently only 1 chapter has been released. A second has been confirmed to be in production.
translation:
在遥远的未来，一场政治会议成为一系列连续谋杀案的目标。罪魁祸首会被发现吗？
目前仅发布了1章。第二个已确认正在生产中。
